text:
maya (People Ops): Hey team — following up from the all-hands: here's a quick live Q&A thread for remote/hybrid + offsite ops. I'll keep answers short and link the handbook pages.

jordan (Eng): If I plan to use the SF satellite for 2 weeks, what's reimbursable for travel and lodging?

maya (People Ops): Domestic flights <= $500, international <= $1,200 unless pre-authorized. Hotels by default mid-range; if you need premium for health reasons, submit the exceptions form. Receipts required for hotel/air.

rebecca (People Ops): Lodging cap is $250/night domestic standard; for high-cost markets (SF, NYC, London) we allow $325/night. Use cost code ops:travel unless you're charging a project.

sasha (Eng-Infra): How do I reserve a team pod for a recurring week when multiple people visit?

carlos (People Ops): File a Team Space Request (link pinned in #people-ops) with dates and headcount. We try to allocate pods for recurring weeks; single ad-hoc days still use the hot-desk flow.

jordan (Eng): If I travel with partner/kids, is that on me? Any childcare help?

maya (People Ops): Family travel is generally not covered. Childcare reimbursement up to $150/day can be approved for parents attending company-sponsored overnight offsites — needs manager sign-off. For spouse travel we consider on a case-by-case basis for accessibility/caregiver reasons.

ana (Finance): Note: expense receipts are required within 14 days via Expensify. Late submissions can delay reimbursements. Attach the event tag and cost code.

sasha (Eng-Infra): Quick question re: transporting equipment between offices (we need a couple of dev GPUs for testing).

carlos (People Ops): Any hardware >$2k requires IT & legal sign-off plus a signed transport form for insurance. Small peripherals ok. Submit IT ticket and mark as "hardware transfer".

jordan (Eng): Visa letters for company-paid international travel — timeline?

maya (People Ops): Start 6-8 weeks ahead for standard visas. We'll prepare an invitation/cover letter; add passport scan and full itinerary to the travel request. Expedited fees are covered with approval.

rebecca (People Ops): Are there expectations about being "on camera" during hybrid weeks? At the all-hands a couple of managers asked how to handle mixed remote/in-person sessions.

maya (People Ops): Best practice: treat hybrid meetings as remote-first — check audio, use a room camera if available, and call out when in-room participants are speaking. If you need meeting facilitation training, we can run a short session.

sasha (Eng-Infra): Desk booking steps? I got confused by the booking site.

carlos (People Ops): Booking flow: internal.redwood.com/office-booking -> site -> select days -> submit. For flex weeks, book by the Wednesday prior to the week. If you're booking 3+ consecutive days, tick "multi-day" to auto-assign a locker.

jordan (Eng): Contractors/temps — any limits on satellite access?

maya (People Ops): Contractors get three free day passes per 30-day window. After that it's $25/day. Vendors must complete vendor onboarding and provide COI. Security will process vendor badges.

ana (Finance): Also: default charge code for decentralised travel is ops:satellite:travel. Teams can override with a project code for chargeback purposes.

jordan (Eng): Home office stipend if I alternate offices often?

rebecca (People Ops): Home office stipend remains $600/year or a one-time ergonomic setup up to $1,200 with manager approval. If you request a permanent desk setup at a satellite, submit the desk-setup form (one-time).

sasha (Eng-Infra): Will the ops team publish a short checklist for managers planning offsites (budget + accessibility needs)?

maya (People Ops): Yes — offsite planning kit is live: https://handbook.redwood.com/offsites/kit. It includes agenda templates, accessibility checklist, and recommended vendors. Use the kit to speed approvals.

offsite-bot: Poll started: "Preferred offsite months" — Apr / May / Sep. Results post in 24h.

jordan (Eng): Thanks all. Can you also confirm whether office snacks are reimbursable for a week-long team offsite?

carlos (People Ops): Small team snacks and coffee for team offsites under 10 people are covered under $150/day cap. For larger events or catering, submit an events budget request.

rebecca (People Ops): I'll consolidate and pin a short FAQ to #people-ops. If anyone needs an exception, tag @carlos or @maya and include the reason and timeline.

maya (People Ops): Closing notes: we'll send a summary email + update the handbook pages mentioned. Thanks for the questions — feel free to DM for 1:1 exceptions. :wave:
